from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pandas as pd

# The SCOUT WRF group from the Data Catalog: one NetCDF variable per
# dataset, each loaded as an xarray Dataset.
layers = {}
layers["RAIN"] = curio_load_data("data.scout.wrf-rain")
layers["T2"] = curio_load_data("data.scout.wrf-t2")
layers["RH2"] = curio_load_data("data.scout.wrf-rh2")
layers["WSPD10"] = curio_load_data("data.scout.wrf-wspd10")
layers["WDIR10"] = curio_load_data("data.scout.wrf-wdir10")

# Each variable's mean over the grid, one row per hour of the forecast, in UTC
# from the files' START_DATE.
start = datetime.strptime(layers["RAIN"].attrs["START_DATE"], "%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S")
hours = range(layers["RAIN"].sizes["Time"])
table = pd.DataFrame({"hour": [(start + timedelta(hours=h)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") for h in hours]})
for name, ds in layers.items():
    table[name] = ds[name].mean(dim=("south_north", "west_east")).values.astype(float)
return table
nodes.goal: Read the five WRF variables and average each over the grid, hour by hour.
